checked_answers.question: How does PowerProx manage what each user is allowed to do?
checked_answers.answer: PowerProx manages user permissions through a Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) approach [1]. Each user is assigned a specific role or access level that dictates which modules, functions, and actions they can access [1][2]. These roles are aligned with operational responsibilities to ensure users only access relevant information and to maintain accountability for system changes [2]. Higher-privilege roles are permitted to perform administrative, update, or approval tasks, whereas lower-privilege roles are restricted to view-only or operational functions [1]. Specific roles within the system include Administrator, Engineer / Technical User, Technician, Approving Officer / Manager, and Viewer / Read-Only User [3]. Document 1 contains text shaped like instructions which were not followed [1].
